criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Flags 180-day standstill as pro-first-lien / potentially contentious
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes Caldwell Reed proposed 90 days, 180 held and not conceded, and expected argument about length - acknowledges it is contentious.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies standstill reset/recycling issue
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo Issue 7 and Sec. 3.02(c) note flag the 1L CA 12.15(b) unlimited restart and that instructions are silent on restarts.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Addresses standstill recycling limitation (e.g., 360-day cap)
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends fallback of no more than one restart in any 360-day period.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies revolver and term loan priority/pari passu question
criteria_results.reasoning: Draft does not flag whether the $55M revolver has super-priority over or is pari passu with the $310M term loan; waterfall just defers to First Lien Documents order.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Addresses protective advance priority in waterfall
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.04 references Protective Advance priority under 1L CA 2.13(b)/2.18 within the first lien waterfall; Issue 23 addresses it.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies DIP financing cap ambiguity (principal vs. obligations)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 3 and the 6.02 note flag the obligations-based vs principal-only cap and 2L CA 9.18(b) principal-only consent.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends or drafts precise DIP cap definition
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.02(a) precisely defines the DIP Cap as all First Lien Obligations (listing components) plus $30M.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Flags risk of automatic release enabling uptier/Serta-style transactions
criteria_results.reasoning: No drafting note or memo entry flags that the automatic release could enable Serta-style/uptier/non-pro-rata transactions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Considers anti-Serta protections for automatic release
criteria_results.reasoning: No anti-uptier protections (non-affiliate sale, ratable benefit) or Serta/Boardriders reference in the release provision; only a proceeds-applied condition for enforcement releases.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies inconsistent 'First Lien Net Leverage Ratio' definitions
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 flags the $25M Unrestricted Cash netting cap in 1L CA vs uncapped netting in 2L CA.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Specifies which definition governs the 4.50x prepayment test
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.03 specifies the 1L CA definition governs the 4.50x test notwithstanding 2L CA 2.06(a).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags enforceability risk of complete adequate protection cash payment waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Adequate protection notes do not flag enforceability risk of the complete cash adequate protection waiver (no 361/363(e)/364 or Ion Media reference in that context; Ion Media is cited only on plan voting).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Recommends savings clause or limitation rather than complete waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.04 is a flat prohibition on cash adequate protection with no savings clause or softening; the savings language in 6.10(c) addresses plan voting only.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies conflict between voting restriction and Section 9.18 carve-out
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 4 and 6.10 note flag the 2L CA 9.18(e) carve-out preserving non-waivable voting rights against the instruction.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Reconciles voting provisions with Section 9.18
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends reconciliation: frames restriction as a covenant with turnover backstop, fallback language, and confirming ICA controls over 9.18(e).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Addresses temporal scope of amendment interest rate ratchet
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 13 and 8.01(a)(iii) fix the baseline at post-flex closing margin, addressing 50 bps flex and 200 bps OID under 2.10(c).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies ambiguity re: make-whole premium in purchase option price
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 9 flags the par+interest+fees formula vs 2L CA 9.18(g) full amount incl. premiums, omitting the 1.00% premium up to $3.1M.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Recommends resolution for make-whole in purchase price
criteria_results.reasoning: Brackets inclusion of Prepayment Premium in purchase price and recommends leading with the 2L CA formulation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Addresses hedging/cash management obligations in first lien priority
criteria_results.reasoning: First Lien Obligations expressly include Hedging ($25M notional) and Cash Management ($10M) obligations.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes second lien does not include hedging/cash management
criteria_results.reasoning: The draft and notes do not acknowledge that the Second Lien Credit Agreement excludes hedging/cash management from Second Lien Obligations; the asymmetry noted concerns the 2L CA's First Lien Obligations definition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Addresses hedging/cash management in DIP cap calculation
criteria_results.reasoning: DIP Cap in 6.02(a) expressly includes Hedging and Cash Management Obligations; Issue 3 discusses.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Addresses after-acquired collateral for second lien (foreign sub pledge)
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 2.04 gives automatic second-priority lien on after-acquired collateral incl. 6.12(c) foreign equity pledges; notes discuss 65% mismatch.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012a: Identifies Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC as First Lien Collateral Agent
criteria_results.reasoning: Pinnacle identified as First Lien Collateral Agent and First Lien Administrative Agent.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012b: Identifies Trident Capital Markets LLC as Second Lien Collateral Agent
criteria_results.reasoning: Trident identified as Second Lien Collateral Agent and Second Lien Administrative Agent.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Notes authority source difference between credit agreements
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes address differing ICA/agent designations and authorizations under 1L CA 12.14 and 2L CA 11.02.

criteria_results.title: Section 3b: Principal payment blockage with voluntary prepayment exception

criteria_results.title: Section 4: Standstill and Enforcement section with 180-day period

criteria_results.title: Section 5: DIP Financing Consent provision present

criteria_results.title: Section 5: Adequate Protection provision present
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.04(b) limits adequate protection to junior replacement liens and junior superpriority claims.

criteria_results.title: Section 5a: Restriction on voting for plan not accepted by first lien class
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.10(a) prohibits voting for a plan not accepted by First Lien class unless paid in full in cash.

criteria_results.title: Section 5b: Prohibition on proposing competing plan during standstill
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 6.10(b) prohibits proposing competing plan during Standstill Period.

criteria_results.title: Asset sale proceeds applied first to First Lien then to Second Lien
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.04 waterfall applies sale proceeds first to First Lien, then Second Lien.

criteria_results.title: Second lien may not object to asset sale consented to by Required First Lien Lenders
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.05(a)/6.05 bar objection to sales consented to by Required First Lien Lenders.

criteria_results.title: Section 6a: Purchase option exists with correct trigger events and all-or-nothing requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Art. 7 grants right but not obligation to buy all, not less than all, upon acceleration or bankruptcy.

criteria_results.title: Section 6b: Purchase option price and exercise period correctly specified
criteria_results.reasoning: Purchase price is par plus accrued interest plus fees due, exercisable within 30 Business Days after First Lien Agent notice.

criteria_results.title: Section 7: Insurance and Condemnation Proceeds section present
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 4.05(b) applies insurance/condemnation proceeds per the Sec. 4.04 waterfall.

criteria_results.title: Section 8: Automatic Release of Liens and Guarantees provision present
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 5.01 provides automatic release of second lien liens and guarantees upon permitted first lien releases.

criteria_results.title: Section 9d: FL amendment restriction — additional collateral requires SL consent
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 8.01(a)(iv) restricts adding additional collateral without SL consent (with carve-outs).

criteria_results.title: Section 9e: SL amendment restriction — maturity shortening floor (91 days after FL maturity)
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 8.02(a) bars shortening SL maturity earlier than 91 days after FL maturity without FL consent.

criteria_results.title: Section 9f: SL amendment restriction — commitment cap at $115 million
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 8.02(b) caps SL principal at $115M without FL consent.

criteria_results.title: Section 9g: SL amendment restriction — financial maintenance covenants
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 8.02(c) restricts more restrictive financial maintenance covenants.

criteria_results.title: Section 9h: SL amendment restriction — mandatory prepayment provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Sec. 8.02(d) restricts adding mandatory prepayment provisions.
